review_route.rationale: High-risk rollback and foreign-data-preservation boundary where a false clean result can leave candidate writes behind.

material_finding.summary: Each restored path is verified immediately, but no final read-only sweep rechecks every current and older mutation after all rollback effects. A later rollback can therefore race an earlier verified path and ordinary EffectFailed can be returned with exact replacement bytes still present.
source_evidence: validator/src/repository_fit/apply.rs:155 restores and immediately verifies the current mutation before older rollback effects run
validator/src/repository_fit/apply.rs:175 restores only the supplied older slice and ends with root validation
validator/src/repository_fit/apply.rs:193 verifies each mutation only immediately after its own compare-exchange

external_reproduction.sequence: Call 2 lands B and reports EffectFailed; call 3 restores and verifies B; call 4 restores A while a concurrent actor recreates exact replacement B after B's only verification.

material_finding.contract_impact: The candidate's assertion that ordinary EffectFailed is returned only when no partial write remains is false under a cross-mutation rollback race.

required_correction: after every current and older rollback attempt, revalidate the exact root and perform a read-only final reconciliation across every attempted mutation against its exact prior state, including absence
classify any replacement, foreign, unreadable, missing-when-prior, present-when-absent, or root-changed final state as RollbackFailed without overwriting foreign bytes
preserve continued safe restoration of older mutations after intermediate failure
add a negative test that recreates the current replacement during a later older rollback after the current mutation's immediate verification
highest_defensible_ceiling: The frozen internal set compiles and its existing per-mutation rollback controls pass, but post-write rollback reconciliation is not accepted.
explicitly_withheld: supported-host writer and live journey proof
readiness release node closure or goal completion
